op-blog.title: OP Blog — Production-Ready Full-Stack CMS
op-blog.summary: A full-stack blog platform built for real content operations: public-facing posts, user profile management, and an admin suite for moderation and analytics. Built with a deliberate zero-bloat philosophy — every dependency questioned, every native API preferred.

features.name: Dynamic Profiles
features.description: Users update bios and upload profile photos via Cloudinary. Profile state is managed through Redux Toolkit async thunks with clean loading and error boundaries.

features.name: Zero-Dependency Toasts
features.description: Custom notification system built on CSS keyframe animations and crypto.randomUUID() — no toast library, no extra bundle weight.

features.name: Async State Management
features.description: Redux Toolkit handles all async data flows — fetching, caching, and optimistic updates — without a single external data-fetching library.

features.name: User Moderation
features.description: Full CRUD operations for the user base, protected behind role-based access control.

features.name: Content Governance
features.description: Post and category management designed for scale — with pagination, filters, and bulk actions.

features.name: Live Dashboard
features.description: Real-time platform metrics updated on admin actions — no polling, no unnecessary re-renders.

features.name: Replaced Framer Motion
features.description: Swapped Framer Motion for optimised CSS animations. Result: a measurably smaller bundle with no JavaScript animation overhead at runtime.

features.name: Replaced nanoid
features.description: Removed the nanoid dependency in favour of native crypto.randomUUID() — one fewer package, identical functionality.

features.name: Native-First Philosophy
features.description: We do not reach for npm install for every small feature. Framer Motion → CSS keyframes. nanoid → crypto.randomUUID(). The result is a fast, maintainable codebase that does not drag the browser.

features.name: Complex State, Clean UI
features.description: Redux Toolkit async thunks manage intricate flows — real-time profile updates, multi-layer content moderation — while the UI stays at 60fps with clear loading and error states.

features.name: Full-Stack Coordination
features.description: Mohamed built a secure, well-structured Node.js and MongoDB backend. Lahcen delivered a responsive, TypeScript-first React frontend. Both sides shaped by the same product brief.

careerhub.title: CareerHub — Production Full-Stack Job Portal
careerhub.summary: A role-based hiring platform built for real-world use: recruiters post and manage jobs, job seekers browse and apply, and admins govern the entire system. Built with zero UI libraries — every component, from the custom DatePicker calendar to the TagsInput and toast system, was engineered from scratch with TypeScript end-to-end and accessibility baked in throughout.

features.name: Token Refresh Queue
features.description: Concurrent 401 responses are queued rather than triggering multiple logouts. A single silent token refresh replays all pending requests on success and gracefully logs out on failure — no lost requests, no double-logout race condition.

features.name: Email Verification & Password Reset
features.description: Full tokenised email flows: account verification on register, re-sent automatically on an unverified login attempt, and a two-step password reset via a secure expiring link.

features.name: Session Validation on Mount
features.description: getMe fires on every app load against the live API. On rejection it clears stale localStorage data before the user sees any authenticated UI — no flash of wrong-role content.

features.name: CanActivate Route Guard
features.description: A shared route guard reads the Redux role and handles the undefined-role window during the getMe network flight — no premature redirect, no blank flash during session validation.

features.name: Admin Panel
features.description: Full user management with search, paginated cache, per-row role assignment, and selective bulk deletion (all users, recruiters only, or regular users only). Cache is wiped automatically after every mutation.

features.name: Recruiter Dashboard
features.description: Job CRUD with a custom DatePicker for deadlines, TagsInput for skills and facilities, and per-application accept/reject backed by optimistic in-slice updates with findIndex splice guard.

features.name: User Dashboard
features.description: Job browsing with server-side search, sort, type, and status filters — apply with a single dispatch, track application status in a paginated cached view with instant page transitions.

features.name: useForm Hook
features.description: A hand-rolled generic form hook with register, registerSelect, registerTags, registerDate, and registerFile registrars. Includes touched-gated live revalidation, a valuesRef for stable blur handlers without stale closures, isDirty tracking, and reset.

features.name: Validation Library
features.description: 12+ declarative rule types — required, minLength, maxLength, pattern, match, enum, optional, fileSize, fileType, minTags, maxTags, minDate, maxDate, custom — with short-circuit evaluation and composable factory helpers. No Zod, no Yup.

features.name: Zero-Dependency UI Controls
features.description: A full-featured DatePicker with min/max range and keyboard navigation, a TagsInput with Enter/comma commit and Backspace removal, and a Select with ARIA combobox role — all built from scratch, no external component library.

features.name: Client-Side Pagination Cache
features.description: Paginated responses are stored in a Redux dictionary keyed by query params. Page navigation is instant. The RTK condition function skips the network request entirely when the key is already cached. Mutations wipe only what is stale.

features.name: Root Reducer State Wipe
features.description: A single state = undefined on the logoutUser/fulfilled action resets every slice simultaneously — auth, jobs, applications, users, admin — leaving zero stale data for the next session.

features.name: Cross-Slice Action Listeners
features.description: The auth slice listens to profile photo and profile update actions from the users slice via extraReducers, keeping the current-user object in sync with localStorage without duplicating state or creating circular imports.

op-market.title: op-market — Full-Stack E-Commerce Platform
op-market.summary: A production-grade online store built on a deliberate constraint: the React frontend ships with zero UI, state, or data-fetching libraries beyond React Router. Every system — caching, forms, modals, notifications — is engineered from scratch, paired with a secure Express and PostgreSQL backend featuring rotating refresh tokens and a full PayPal Checkout integration.

features.name: Hand-Built Cache Store
features.description: A Map-based cache store built on React's useSyncExternalStore, with a subscribe/notify system that updates only the components watching a specific piece of data — no external state library, no unnecessary re-render storms.

features.name: Deterministic Keys & Request Deduplication
features.description: Query parameters are sorted before being hashed into cache keys, so identical requests fired from unrelated components always resolve to the same cache entry — and concurrent duplicate fetches are automatically merged into a single network call.

features.name: Three Deliberate Invalidation Strategies
features.description: Exact-key removal, prefix-wide invalidation, and in-place merge updates are each chosen per mutation type — so an admin product edit reflects on the live storefront instantly, with zero manual refresh anywhere in the app.

features.name: Rotating Refresh Tokens with Request Queueing
features.description: Concurrent 401 responses trigger a single deduplicated silent token refresh instead of a storm of parallel refresh calls, with every pending request automatically replayed once the new token is issued.

features.name: Full PayPal Checkout Integration
features.description: A complete create → approve → capture/cancel payment lifecycle, with real browser redirects to PayPal's own checkout and an idempotent capture endpoint that safely tolerates page reloads mid-confirmation.

features.name: Tokenised Email Verification & Password Reset
features.description: Secure, expiring links for account verification and password recovery — resetting a password automatically revokes every active refresh token on the account, locking out any compromised session.

features.name: Code-Split Admin Panel
features.description: The entire admin dashboard is lazy-loaded via React.lazy and Suspense, so its code never ships to an anonymous shopper browsing the storefront — only fetched the moment an authenticated admin navigates there.

features.name: Full Product, Order & User Management
features.description: Complete CRUD for the product catalogue with Cloudinary image uploads, an order status workflow from pending to delivered, and role-based user management, all backed by paginated, filterable, cached tables.

features.name: Self-Lockout Prevention
features.description: The backend has no built-in protection against an admin demoting their own account and losing dashboard access — so the frontend disables that specific action for your own account, a safeguard we designed in after spotting the gap.

features.name: Race-Condition-Safe Cart Updates
features.description: Cart quantity changes are disabled mid-mutation and merged directly into the cache on success, preventing out-of-order responses from silently saving the wrong quantity — with memoised product cards that skip re-rendering on every search keystroke.

features.name: Accessibility Built In, Not Bolted On
features.description: Skip-to-content links, focus restored to the page's main landmark on every route change, a real keyboard focus trap in every modal, and ARIA-correct tables, forms, and live regions throughout.

features.name: SEO Within a Single-Page App's Real Limits
features.description: Per-page meta tags, canonical links, and schema.org JSON-LD structured data on every product page — with noindex correctly applied to authenticated routes a crawler should never index.

mvp.title: MVP Delivery
mvp.subtitle: Ship a production-ready product with tight scope and measurable outcomes.
bullets: Opinionated stack: React + TypeScript frontend, Node.js + Express backend, MongoDB or MySQL.
Well-shaped API contracts before implementation — no over-fetch, no last-minute schema changes.
Weeks to first deploy, not months — iterative roadmap with scope-locked milestones.
Production checklist included: logging, monitoring, error boundaries, and deploy pipelines.

scaling.title: Full-Stack Scaling
scaling.subtitle: Make your product handle real traffic — without rewriting it.
bullets: API profiling and bottleneck analysis: slow queries, N+1 patterns, and missing indexes.
Queue-based workers, horizontal Node.js scaling, and autoscaling configuration guidance.
Observability plan: structured logs, lightweight metrics, and actionable alerting.
Infrastructure recommendations sized for predictable costs as traffic grows.

bullets: Frontend: bundle analysis, critical render path, code-splitting, and asset optimisation.
Backend: query plans, index gaps, cache strategy, and response payload review.
Concrete P0 → P3 fix list — each item with estimated effort and expected impact.
Optional implementation sprint to apply the highest-priority fixes immediately.
